Copy a DT of an epi_archive, replacing its time_value and version columns

Source: R/vstretched_numeric_formats.R
dtbl_with_time_values_versions.Rd

The result's other columns are deep copies of dtbl's, so they don't alias dtbl. To avoid extra copies, time_values and versions are used directly as the new columns, not copied, so callers should pass freshly computed vectors that they won't use elsewhere: the result may modify them in place (e.g., the setkeyv() below may reorder them).

Usage

dtbl_with_time_values_versions(dtbl, time_values, versions)

Arguments

dtbl

the DT of an epi_archive.

time_values, versions

vectors with as many entries as dtbl has rows, to become the result's time_value and version columns.

Value

a data.table with the same column order and key as dtbl.
